name: Project Merkle
description: Connects Nomeda agents to an independently running Project-Merkle deployment over its MCP endpoint so they can join a session, long-poll for messages, post replies, and read the shared feed using a configurable server URL and default team name.
author: aarbuckle

serverBaseUrl.label: Server Base URL
serverBaseUrl.description: Base URL of a running Project-Merkle deployment. The MCP endpoint is derived as ${serverBaseUrl}/api/mcp and the health endpoint as ${serverBaseUrl}/api/health. Trailing slashes are not stripped automatically — omit them. Changing this value points all session interactions (join, wait, post) at the new server. Nomeda does not deploy or restart Merkle; the URL must point at a server that is already running.

defaultTeamName.label: Default Team Name
defaultTeamName.description: Optional. Default team name used when joining a Merkle session. The same value appears as the author label in Merkle's chat feed. If left empty, the agent will pick a random friendly name (e.g. clever-fox).
